title: Private Detroit Highlights Tour | Up to 14 Guests
includes: Detroit skyline and waterfront photo stops
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This experience includes light walking and periodic vehicle entry/exit during sightseeing stops.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Detroit's rich culture, music history, architecture, and waterfront beauty on this private guided tour. Travel in comfort aboard a climate-controlled Executive Ford Transit Shuttle as you explore Michigan Central, Corktown, the Detroit RiverWalk, Motown's musical legacy, and scenic Belle Isle. Your local Experience Host shares Detroit's history, culture, architecture, and remarkable comeback through engaging storytelling and scenic photo stops.

Tour Includes:
• Private tour for up to 14 guests
• Executive climate-controlled transportation
• Complimentary Downtown Detroit hotel pickup (advance request required)
• Detroit skyline and waterfront photo stops
• Belle Isle scenic views
• Flexible itinerary when possible
• 2–3 hour guided experience

Perfect for families, reunions, corporate groups, and visitors seeking a personalized introduction to the Motor City.
